playground. Next, teachers could remind students to throw trash
in the bins. Then, we could have a "Clean-up Day" every Friday.
If we do these things, our playground will be clean and beautiful.
Students will be healthier, and the environment will be better.

listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
A good problem-solution paragraph has:
1. A clear PROBLEM statement
2. REASONS why it's a problem
3. A detailed SOLUTION (steps)
4. The RESULT if we follow the solution
Example:
"Our school playground has too much trash. This is a problem because
it looks ugly and it is unhealthy for students. Also, animals might
eat the trash and get sick.
I have a solution. First, we should put more trash bins around the
playground. Next, teachers could remind students to throw trash
in the bins. Then, we could have a "Clean-up Day" every Friday.
If we do these things, our playground will be clean and beautiful.
Students will be healthier, and the environment will be better.
I believe this plan will work if everyone helps!"

"12 shared among 4 is 3"
"Each friend gets 3 cookies"
"The quotient is 3"
